description: LLMs can be tested for situational awareness using behavioral tasks that measure their ability to recognize their own generated text, predict their behavior, and distinguish between evaluation and deployment.

instances.assertion: LLMs can be tested for situational awareness using behavioral tasks that measure their ability to recognize their own generated text, predict their behavior, and distinguish between evaluation and deployment.
LLMs can be prompted to demonstrate situational awareness, such as knowing their own identity, training data, and deployment context.
